text:
```yaml
name: Mark stale issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for stale issues and PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          stale-pr-label: 'stale'
          days-before-stale: 30
          days-before-close: 7
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been marked stale because it has not had activity in the last 30 days.
            Please add a comment or close the issue if it is no longer relevant.
          stale-pr-message: |
            This PR has been marked stale because it has not had activity in the last 30 days.
            Please add a comment or close the PR if it is no longer relevant.
          close-issue-message: |
            Closing this issue because it has been stale for 7 days.
          close-pr-message: |
            Closing this PR because it has been stale for 7 days.
          exempt-issue-labels: 'documentation,help wanted,question'
          exempt-pr-labels: 'documentation,help wanted,question'
          operations-per-run: 30
          debug-only: false
```
